data.label: Google Basics
data.title:
5 Local SEO basics
to *get found locally*
data.sub: Swipe to see if your business is ready →

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: Claim your *Google Business* profile
data.body: This is the most important step to appear on Google Maps. It tells locals exactly where you are and what services you offer.
data.fix: Fix: Claim your business on Google Business Profile today.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title: Use your *city name* on your site
data.body: Google needs to know your service area. Mentioning your city clearly helps you rank when locals search for nearby help.
data.fix: Fix: Add your city name to your homepage title tag.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: Ask for *customer reviews*
data.body: Positive reviews build trust with new clients and signal to Google that your business is active and reliable.
data.fix: Fix: Send a text link to three recent happy customers.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: Make your site *mobile friendly*
data.body: Most people searching for local services are using their phones. If your site is hard to use, they will leave immediately.
data.fix: Fix: Open your site on your phone and test buttons.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: List your *name, address, phone*
data.body: Consistency is key for local search. Ensure your contact info is identical across your website and all social media profiles.
data.fix: Fix: Update your website footer with your current address.
